test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word in the following sentence.**

Traitor
solution:
The correct answer is: **Loyal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Traitor **means a person who is not loyal to his/her country, friends, etc. (देश, मित्र आदि से ग़द्दारी करने वाला; देशद्रोही, मित्रद्रोही, ग़द्दार)

 
 
• **For example-** *Griffin called Bonner a traitor, a snitch and a spy. *
 
 
 
• Marked option **Loyal **means a firm resistance to any temptation to desert or betray. (त्यागने या विश्वासघात करने के किसी भी प्रलोभन का दृढ़ प्रतिरोध)
 
 
• **For example-** *His loyal wife stood by him throughout his trial and imprisonment.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the antonym of 'Traitor' is 'Loyal' as they are opposite in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of other words.
 
 
• **Honest**: telling the truth or able to be trusted and not likely to steal, cheat, or lie. (सत्‍याचरण करने वाला, ईमानदार; चोरी आदि असत्‍याचरण न करने वाला)
 
• **Defender**: a person who defends someone or something from attack, assault, or injury. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी व्यक्ति या चीज़ को हमले, हमले या चोट से बचाता है)
 
• **Betrayer**: a person who is not loyal to their country or to another person, often doing something harmful such as giving information to an enemy. (ऐसा व्यक्ति जो अपने देश या किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के प्रति वफादार नहीं है, अक्सर कुछ हानिकारक कार्य करता है जैसे किसी दुश्मन को जानकारी देना)
